dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: Greetings. I handle all manner of affairs regarding Fontaine's security.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About security...

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: The Gardemeks are in charge of daily security matters, and they aid their corresponding Gardes officers in conducting patrols.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: Machines are not omnipotent, after all. There are many things that can only be accomplished by humans.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: Gardemeks and the Gardes are both under the Maison Gardiennage.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: If something arises that they, too, cannot handle, then it shall be up to the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, or the Chief Justice's personal unit, the Marechaussee Phantom.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shan't bother you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: See you, in that case.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol...

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: They are the elite of the Maison Gardiennage.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: They handle affairs that ordinary Gardes would struggle with — such as criminals who refuse to negotiate and attempt to resist violently.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: Normally, criminals who still maintain the spark of rationality would surrender upon encountering the Patrol.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As for the Marechaussee Phantom...

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: That organization was once comprised only of humans, but now the majority of them are Melusines.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: They were added in when the Chief Justice noticed that their special visual acuity was most suited to investigating cases.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: I apologize if I get a little excited at times. Please understand.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: After all, the lovely Melusines are treasured companions of us Fontainians.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You must really like Melusines.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: Yes, and I never conceal my love for them.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: As a cardinal assistant that handles city defense affairs, I am obliged to emphasize that—

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: Though Melusines are tiny, adorable beings, they are Fontainian citizens, not pets or monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Plessia
dialogues.text: I will not allow any inappropriate thoughts regarding Melusines.
